primaryChecks.text: A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. Elisha said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”
primaryChecks.previousContext: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.
primaryChecks.nextContext: His servant said, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?” But he said, “Give it to the people, that they may eat; for the LORD says, ‘They will eat, and will have some left over.’”
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 候補索引の用例と固定本文を照合し、場所との関係は文脈上の対応としてのみ扱う。
